_comment: Add a project = one entry here. The page renders itself from this file.

projects.name: Metatron
projects.what: A local image-to-3D forge. Feed it one reference photo, get back a textured mesh.
does: Runs Hunyuan3D locally on a single GPU
Orchestrates its own VRAM so a 12GB card can host the engine and an LLM without either dying
Queue, live forge log, in-browser preview of the result
Exports textured GLB at up to 100k tris

projects.name: Cloe
projects.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on my own machine and keeps its own memory.
does: Local model, no subscription, no data leaving the machine
Persistent memory with real timestamps — she says 'I don't know' rather than inventing one
Desktop overlay UI built in Tauri

projects.name: Mytheder
projects.what: A Czech party card game, rebuilt from an abandoned repo and given a new identity for a Discord community.
does: Private rooms, five-character join codes, no accounts
1016 cards across five themed packs, loaded from JSON — no database
Chat, reconnect with backoff, rooms held open 90s for dropped players
Whole theme is three colour tokens: re-skinning is a config change

projects.name: Monkey Paw
projects.what: One player makes a wish. Everyone else writes the catch that makes them regret it.
does: Free text instead of a deck — nothing ever runs out
A monkey's paw that curls one finger per wish spent
Czech or English, chosen per room
Built on the same engine lessons as Mytheder
